description: STAR-based behavioral competencies for German job interviews

competencies.name: Teamwork & Collaboration
competencies.description: Ability to work effectively within a team, contribute to group goals, and support colleagues.
competencies.description_de: Fähigkeit, effektiv im Team zu arbeiten, zu Gruppenzielen beizutragen und Kollegen zu unterstützen.
competencies.german_context: Relevant for Praktikum, Werkstudent, group thesis, or university project teams.

competencies.name: Problem Solving Under Pressure
competencies.description: Ability to identify problems, analyze options, and implement solutions in challenging situations.
competencies.description_de: Fähigkeit, Probleme zu identifizieren, Optionen zu analysieren und Lösungen in herausfordernden Situationen umzusetzen.
competencies.german_context: Common in thesis projects, deadlines during Studium, or urgent tasks at Werkstudent jobs.

competencies.name: Initiative & Proactivity
competencies.description: Taking action without being asked, identifying opportunities for improvement, going beyond assigned tasks.
competencies.description_de: Handeln ohne Aufforderung, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten erkennen, über zugewiesene Aufgaben hinausgehen.
competencies.german_context: Highly valued in German companies — Eigeninitiative is specifically mentioned in many job descriptions.

competencies.name: Adaptability & Learning Agility
competencies.description: Ability to quickly adapt to new environments, tools, requirements, or feedback.
competencies.description_de: Fähigkeit, sich schnell an neue Umgebungen, Tools, Anforderungen oder Feedback anzupassen.
competencies.german_context: Important during Praktikum in new industry, switching tech stack, or new team environments.

competencies.name: Communication & Stakeholder Management
competencies.description: Ability to communicate clearly, manage expectations, and present complex information accessibly.
competencies.description_de: Fähigkeit, klar zu kommunizieren, Erwartungen zu managen und komplexe Informationen verständlich darzustellen.
star_cues: How did you adjust your message?
competencies.german_context: Presentations, written reports, cross-functional meetings in German corporate culture.

competencies.name: Leadership & Taking Ownership
competencies.description: Taking responsibility for outcomes, leading others informally or formally, driving results.
competencies.description_de: Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernehmen, andere informell oder formal führen, Ergebnisse vorantreiben.
competencies.german_context: Even as a student, leading a seminar group, thesis project, or student organization.

competencies.name: Conflict Resolution
competencies.description: Handling disagreements professionally, finding compromise, maintaining working relationships.
competencies.description_de: Meinungsverschiedenheiten professionell handhaben, Kompromisse finden, Arbeitsbeziehungen aufrechterhalten.
star_cues: How did you approach the other person?
competencies.german_context: Direct communication style expected in Germany — avoiding conflict is not valued.

competencies.name: Time Management & Prioritization
competencies.description: Managing multiple tasks, meeting deadlines, prioritizing effectively under competing demands.
competencies.description_de: Mehrere Aufgaben verwalten, Fristen einhalten, effektiv priorisieren bei konkurrierenden Anforderungen.
star_cues: How did you decide what to prioritize?
competencies.german_context: Punctuality and reliability (Pünktlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit) are core values in German work culture.

competencies.name: Learning from Failure
competencies.description: Acknowledging mistakes openly, extracting lessons, and applying them to future work.
competencies.description_de: Fehler offen eingestehen, Lektionen ziehen und sie auf zukünftige Arbeit anwenden.
star_cues: How did you apply the lesson?
competencies.german_context: German interviewers appreciate intellectual honesty and systematic learning from mistakes.

competencies.name: Cross-Cultural Collaboration
competencies.description: Working effectively with people from different cultural backgrounds, adapting communication style.
competencies.description_de: Effektives Arbeiten mit Menschen aus verschiedenen kulturellen Hintergründen, Kommunikationsstil anpassen.
star_cues: What cultural differences did you notice?
competencies.german_context: Very relevant for international students applying to German companies — speak to your own experience.
